subject: Formatting labels, positioning legend box in plots using facet_wrap()

messages.author: fba32125661ad1d0
messages.subject: Formatting labels, positioning legend box in plots using facet_wrap()
parts:
Hi group,

I am a new user of ggplot2. Great package!

I tried to plot multiple plots using facet_wrap(). The plots look
good; however I am having trouble in labelling the strips and
formatting the legend box.
a) Is it possible to modify the individual labels of the facets
(currently the label shows values 0, 1 etc of the factor, where as
ideally I want to show "θ=0", "θ=1", etc.)
b) I tried to place the legend box at the bottom of the plot using
opts(legend.position = "bottom") but it doesn't work.

> p+opts(legend.position="bottom")
Error in grid.Call.graphics("L_setviewport", pvp, TRUE) :
Non-finite location and/or size for viewport

Please suggest how to resolve these issues? I am using R 2.10.1 and
ggplot2 0.8.7

TIY,
KG

messages.author: 5ec5102a43e29af7
messages.subject: Re: Formatting labels, positioning legend box in plots using facet_wrap()
parts:
On Sun, Mar 21, 2010 at 05:53:24AM -0700, KG wrote:
> I tried to plot multiple plots using facet_wrap(). The plots look
> good; however I am having trouble in labelling the strips and
> formatting the legend box.
> a) Is it possible to modify the individual labels of the facets
> (currently the label shows values 0, 1 etc of the factor, where as
> ideally I want to show "θ=0", "θ=1", etc.)

convert your factor variable to character and replace them your prefered
labels.

> b) I tried to place the legend box at the bottom of the plot using
> opts(legend.position = "bottom") but it doesn't work

The bottom position is currently not supported.

regards,
stefan
